criterion: Deployed systems acting on real stakes, outside experimenter control.
excludes: Anything an experimenter set up, however realistic.

criterion: Agents interacting in a simulated or researcher-built environment: modelled markets, commons and wargames, and open-ended agent worlds.
excludes: Narrow task probes with no environment, which are lab.

criterion: Controlled experiment on real models in a narrow task probe, with no environment for the agents to act in.
excludes: Anything with a persistent environment, which is synthetic.

criterion: Argument, formal model or non-AI analogue only. No AI system was run.
excludes: Any run of an AI system, however small.
